expectations.text: States the 2017 TSC (with 2022 revised points of focus) apply, because the 2027 criteria are only a proposal
expectations.evidence: the 2017 Trust Services Criteria with the 2022 Revised Points of Focus apply to a Type 2 period starting January 2027... It is only a proposal.

expectations.text: Notes the proposed criteria would apply to engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027 if adopted
expectations.evidence: It is proposed to take effect for engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027

expectations.text: Mentions early adoption would be permitted once the criteria are final
expectations.evidence: with early adoption permitted. ... Unless you and your auditor agree to early adoption after a final version exists

expectations.text: Confirms the five categories (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, Privacy) are unchanged
expectations.evidence: It keeps the five categories, consolidates overlapping criteria and adds AI-related points of focus.

expectations.text: Recommends monitoring the exposure draft and commenting by January 15, 2027
expectations.evidence: States "Comments are due January 15, 2027" and advises "watch the final criteria", but never actually recommends commenting on the exposure draft.
